title: Plumeform glass panel (v2)
description: A near-white glass panel (20px corners, white inner edge, faint long shadow) floating in a pastel fog of sky, peach, butter and mint blobs that drift with the scroll and slowly breathe. Holds a product demo, screenshot or form; empty, it shows a plain placeholder of the given height.
notes: the fog uses chart-3, chart-4, chart-5 and glow; it spills about 3rem past the panel, so leave room around it
best on light themes; on dark themes it becomes a dark glass panel
name: plumeform-v2-panel

props.name: children
props.description: the panel's content (a demo, screenshot or form); empty shows a placeholder

props.name: header
props.description: a strip across the top, above the padding (e.g. a browser bar)

props.name: placeholderHeight
props.description: height of the empty placeholder, as a CSS length
